text:
Gold Price in 1974
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1974, the LBMA gold price rose 40.8% between 1974-01-31 ($133) and 1974-12-31 ($187). The highest sampled price was $187 in December and the lowest was $133 in January. The mean of these observations was $162. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
